basic_profile.bio: A gaming enthusiast with a soft spot for RPGs, especially the Fallout series. Originally from Colorado, I now work as a software developer in Austin, Texas. Married to a fellow gamer, we often spend our weekends exploring virtual worlds together. I'm typically online in the evenings after work and during weekends, delving into gaming discussions or catching up with the latest tech news.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in software development, with a degree in Computer Science from the University of Colorado. I have a deep-seated passion for gaming, particularly RPGs, which has led me to become quite knowledgeable about game mechanics and modding. I regularly follow gaming news and updates to stay informed.
